neighbours.label: Narration about sea creatures and ships (fish found along the coast, a whale stranded on the beach, a vessel used by the navy, the ship went down), on the verbs and prepositions that follow them; quiet on the same sentences about land animals and aircraft.
fire: Several kinds of shark are found in the warm waters near the reef.
Last week a young seal was spotted on the pier near the harbor.
The frigate was a warship used by the British to patrol the coast.
Salmon return to the rivers where they were born to spawn.
When the ferry sank in the storm, fishermen rescued most of the crew.
Sea turtles lay their eggs on the same beaches every year.
Orcas hunt in family groups and share their catch.
The old whaling ship was anchored off the island for the winter.
quiet: Several kinds of lizard are found in the dry hills near the town.
Last week a young fox was spotted on the porch near the barn.
The tank was a vehicle used by the British to patrol the border.
Elk return to the meadows where they were born each spring.
When the barn burned in the storm, neighbors rescued most of the horses.
Wild geese build their nests in the same fields every year.
Wolves hunt in family groups and share their kill.
The old freight train was parked outside the station for the winter.
